commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+5' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.

90+2' A neat pass is well received by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The attendance for today's match is 13512.

88' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the left side of the target as Unai Simon produces a good save.
87' Here comes a substitution. Oihan Sancet is given a rest as he is replaced by Selton Sanchez (Ath Bilbao).
86' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Mikel Jauregizar is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ilias Akhomach will be replaced by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano).
85' The main referee, Victor Garcia, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card for dissent.
83' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
81' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
78' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
76' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
73' A goal, which was scored by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano), was disallowed due to offside.
73' Here is a change. Jesus Areso is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).
71' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao).
70' Substitution. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) on for Isi Palazon.
69' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
69' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

69' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
66' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Augusto Batalla, who makes a comfortable save.
65' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
63' A cross into the box from Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Nobel Mendy.
61' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
61' The game has come to an end for Gerard Gumbau. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
59' Ernesto Valverde is forced to make a change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta is unable to continue due to injury, Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
56' The game is interrupted. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) suffers a horrific injury!
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
53' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
51' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
47' 1 - 1 Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a promising position after getting on the end of a pass and fires the ball inside the left post!
47' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ernesto Valverde gives a chance to Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) and Unai Gomez is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
40' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Victor Garcia ignores the protests.
40' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) for a tough tackle.
37' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Victor Garcia to decide. The relieved Rayo Vallecano players can finally celebrate.
36' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Victor Garcia wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.

35' 1 - 0 Goal! Alvaro Garcia displays great vision and sends a pass to Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
35' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
31' Victor Garcia blows his whistle. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after dangerous play.
31' The opposition give Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
29' A lofted pass finds Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.

26' What a save from Unai Simon! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
25' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
23' The cross into the penalty area from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
20' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
17' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
17' The free kick is delivered by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
16' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
13' Half-chance! Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) plays a pass into the box, but Unai Simon reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

9' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) launches himself at the ball from the resulting free kick and directs a header to the right side of the goal, but the effort is diverted onto the post by Unai Simon. Tremendous save!
8' Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul after Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick is awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

4' What a chance that is! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
4' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
4' It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.

3' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Unai Simon is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
